title: NetworkFriendRemovedPayload
description: network.friend.removed v1 (plan §AB.51): `from` removed `to` (or blocked them): they are no longer friends, and no request stays open from `from`. Written to Network's outbox in the transaction that stores the change. Envelope: subject { type: user, id: <to> }, visibility subject, actor <from>.

revision.description: Grows with every change of this pair; apply the latest.
